title: In Quest of an Extensible Multi-Level Harm Taxonomy for Adversarial AI: Heart of Security, Ethical Risk Scoring and Resilience Analytics
reasoning: The paper is centered on developing an ethical harm taxonomy for AI, grounding its framework in 11 ethical theories (including Deontology, Utilitarianism, and Virtue Ethics) and including 'Faith, Belief, and Worldviews' as a category of victim entity.
